The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a clear gap between the performance of state of the art algorithms and the requirements for industrial applications, which is why the dataset is expected to be useful for the research community.

the T-LESS dataset can serve as a benchmark for evaluating the current state of the art and for developing new algorithms for 6D object localization and pose estimation in texture-less and cluttered scenes.

there is a strong need for a public dataset for 6D object/scene pose estimation that contains challenging objects and scenes, which are not only texture-less and symmetric but also exhibit mutual similarities and are parts of other objects.
